agents_ended_idx.name: agents_ended_idx
agents_ended_idx.where: "agents"."terminated_at" is not null or "agents"."archived_at" is not null

agents_live_credential.name: agents_live_credential
agents_live_credential.value: "agents"."credential_id" IS NOT NULL OR "agents"."terminated_at" IS NOT NULL

agents_terminated_ephemeral.name: agents_terminated_ephemeral
agents_terminated_ephemeral.value: "agents"."kind" = 'ephemeral' OR ("agents"."terminated_at" IS NULL AND "agents"."terminated_by" IS NULL)

skill_sources_kind_fields_check.name: skill_sources_kind_fields_check
skill_sources_kind_fields_check.value:
("skill_sources"."kind" = 'folder' AND "skill_sources"."path" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("skill_sources"."kind" = 'github' AND "skill_sources"."repo" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_sources"."subpath" IS NOT NULL
          AND "skill_sources"."branch" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_sources"."commit" IS NOT NULL)

schedules_due_idx.name: schedules_due_idx
schedules_due_idx.where: "schedules"."deleted_at" is null and "schedules"."paused_at" is null and "schedules"."next_run_at" is not null

task_links_agent_check.name: task_links_agent_check
task_links_agent_check.value: ("task_links"."kind" = 'agent') = ("task_links"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_links"."target" IS NULL)
